answer: In a decentralized consensus network, AI agents can utilize a reputation-based Sybil resistance mechanism, leveraging a "falcon" node reputation system. Each agent is assigned a unique identifier tied to its karst topography-inspired proof-of-work. The fable of Sybil attacks is mitigated as agents must expend computational resources to create new identities, making it costly for an attacker to create multiple fake identities, thereby securing the network.
